89daf9dc-075a-4aa5-873a-cc76bb287108.title: Gokushufudou
89daf9dc-075a-4aa5-873a-cc76bb287108.description:
Immortal Tatsu is an ex-yakuza who’s given up violence for making an honest man of himself - but is it still possible for a devoted stay-at-home husband to get into a few scrapes?

---

- Winner of the 2020 Eisner Award in the Best Humor Publication category.

dd16dbbc-c317-4f62-8cf5-3525b4083aab.title: Prologue-eseo 30-nyeoni Heulleotda
dd16dbbc-c317-4f62-8cf5-3525b4083aab.description:
I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before.

For 30 years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG.
I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending.
But...

Those 30 years were only the prologue.
It turns out the real story is about an academy?

1dd14e17-2e54-4e7c-a511-cf597a05538f.title: Kono Koi, Ittan Mochikaerasete Itadakimasu!
1dd14e17-2e54-4e7c-a511-cf597a05538f.altTitle: I'll Take this Love Home with Me for Now!
1dd14e17-2e54-4e7c-a511-cf597a05538f.description: Kuroiwa, a high-powered career woman who finds no joy in romance, is approached at a bar by Mashiro, a woman who’s her complete opposite, and they end up spending the night together. Thinking it was a one-night mistake, Kuroiwa then discovers that Mashiro is actually a junior at her company, and Mashiro even confesses that she likes Kuroiwa...!? Undeterred by workplace boundaries, the romance-obsessed junior Mashiro pursues her relentlessly, and Kuroiwa is gradually won over.

609e536a-5b8e-4fc7-b1c1-5fcccc96ed1d.title: Red Erewhon
609e536a-5b8e-4fc7-b1c1-5fcccc96ed1d.description: In a time when Gods ruled with cruelty, no one dared to oppose them! A girl was offered to the wind god as a sacrifice. A tribe leader sets off on a journey of redemption while trying to save the girl and make her his wife. Kiron, while defying the Gods will, departs for a difficult journey. Will he be successful? And what kind of obstacles will the Gods throw at him?

10263dc2-dd53-4099-bf57-cad6c4acc14b.title: The Count's Youngest Son Is a Gamer
10263dc2-dd53-4099-bf57-cad6c4acc14b.description:
Dohyeon is a top-ranking gamer in Connect, an immersive VR game that is overrun by corrupt guilds. After being murdered for discovering a mythical item, he wakes up as Lord Raul Ashton, an NPC in a closed beta version of Connect. 

Now the sole player in this realm, he decides to use his knowledge from his past life to prevent the downfall of House Ashton and unlock unprecedented powers. For Dohyeon, Connect is no longer just a game—it’s now his reality. 

Join him as he embarks on a thrilling quest to reshape his fate!

4338f69e-df9d-464e-bd63-f0863281df6e.title: Danggol
4338f69e-df9d-464e-bd63-f0863281df6e.description:
At Yeongweoldang shrine lives Kim Seo-ryeong, a veteran mansin (female shaman). Noh Seung-rae, who was born into a shaman family yet has spent his life rejecting the calling, seeks her help because his young daughter has suddenly lost her sight.

Offended by Seung-rae’s scornful disbelief in shamanism, Seo-ryeong turns him down and leaves. But that very night — and every night after — unsettling dreams invade Seo-ryeong’s sleep, showing her fragments of Seung-rae’s past.

Unable to ignore the signs, she starts investigating the household… and the aura surrounding that little girl is anything but ordinary!

2b5a3b43-effb-4f54-aa9b-d6093d523452.title: Silent Witch: Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto
2b5a3b43-effb-4f54-aa9b-d6093d523452.description: Keajaiban tidak membutuhkan nyanyian. Ini adalah kisah tentang penyihir terlemah, paling pemalu, namun terkuat, dan bagaimana dia dilahirkan kembali, semuanya menjadi sebuah buku. (Penyihir Keheningan) Monica Everett. Satu-satunya penyihir di dunia yang bisa menggunakan sihir diam (tanpa nyanyian), dan seorang pahlawan muda yang membunuh sendiri naga hitam legendaris itu. Tapi apa sifat aslinya?? Alasan sebenarnya saya berlatih sihir diam adalah agar saya tidak perlu berbicara di depan umum. Ketika Monica terpilih sebagai salah satu dari 7 Watchers, tanpa disadari, dia terpaksa mengambil misi rahasia untuk melindungi pangeran kedua…? Lemah dan pemalu, namun yang terkuat. Penyihir surgawi yang antisosial menyembunyikan identitas aslinya dan diam-diam membawa kejahatan ke pengadilan melawan pangeran dalam fantasi yang menyakitkan! Fantasi penyihir web, terlahir kembali menjadi sebuah buku, dengan tambahan! Apa yang akan menjadi misteri baru yang berdiri di depan Monica Everett…?

b226efca-4b5e-4954-8382-8f29b2305c33.title: Zettai Aku no Kaibutsu
b226efca-4b5e-4954-8382-8f29b2305c33.description: "The Fukurogi Incident" — a serial murder case in which 23 murderers met their end at the hands of an active police officer, Fukurogi Nodoka. Nodoka, presumed dead after her execution, awakens to find herself informed by a mysterious girl, Lassey, that she's been made to participate in a battle royale between resurrected heinous murderers. Nodoka, driven by the desire to prevent further atrocities by these resurrected criminals and eliminate their kind from the world, plunges into this distasteful game.

b8249e7e-cd20-43f3-b961-f47ad1070ab0.description:
"No talent, no money, no education. A worthless person, bottom of the barrel."
"But... just seeing you like that makes me feel so happy."

Shinba, an unemployed young man, is what someone could call a useless person. For some reason, such a man is dating a cool and beautiful woman named Hizumi. For the sake of Hizumi, whom he loves very much, Shinba tries to graduate from being a useless person, but his efforts are always in vain. She ridicule, sneers and deny him. She whisper words of love to him and stays by his side.

d4ad9513-115e-477f-b366-d27b440261b2.title: Dragon Ball AF (Young Jijii)
d4ad9513-115e-477f-b366-d27b440261b2.description:

Dragon Ball AF has no affiliation with Akira Toriyama, Funamation, Toei Animation, or Fuji TV. Dragon Ball AF is a fan-made doujinshi created by Young Jijii and is made purely for entertainment.

2bbf1216-48fb-469e-8312-75003c7c96ab.altTitle: I Should Have Been Reincarnated as a Supporting Role, but Before I Knew It, I Had Become a Legendary Alchemist
2bbf1216-48fb-469e-8312-75003c7c96ab.description:
After being reincarnated into the world of the popular RPG Albater, a former gamer discovers that he hasn't become the protagonist or one of the game's legendary heroes. Instead, he's now Eisuke, a minor supporting character whose class is Alchemist. Being a background character doesn't bother Eisuke in the slightest. Armed with extensive knowledge of the game, he plans to take full advantage of his alchemy skills, make a fortune, and live a successful life far away from the dangers awaiting the story's main cast.

But staying in the background proves easier said than done. Before long, Eisuke crosses paths with Ain, the game's supposed protagonist, only to discover that the “hero” is nowhere near as capable as he should be. Worse, if Ain dies, the entire world could be doomed. Eisuke reluctantly begins using his knowledge and abilities to support him, gradually earning far more attention than any minor character is supposed to receive. As he forms a party with the game's heroes and heroines, Eisuke's supposedly humble support role becomes increasingly indispensable. He may have been reincarnated as a mere side character, but before he knows it, his talents as an alchemist are putting him on the path toward becoming a legend in his own right.
___
